verdict.rationale: Refunds are a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies, but no evidence item mentions issuing full or partial refunds from the dashboard or the API. The general API docs and the merchant-of-record claim about handling 'fraud' do not describe a refund capability. Missing for 10: any documented refund capability (full or partial), dashboard refund flow, refund API endpoint.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can issue full or partial refunds from both the dashboard and the API
